hero.title: Investment criteria
hero.subtitle: Is your business the right fit? Criteria for strategic growth

intro: We invest in majority and substantial minority equity recapitalizations of profitable, founder-led technology and tech-enabled businesses in the US and Canada, with a focus on technology distribution and implementation: VARs, cybersecurity providers, and the companies that deploy and support technology for their customers.

criteria.note: Proposed criteria from CLAUDE.md; public wording not yet confirmed. Live site says '$2M+ in EBITDA and $8M+ in Revenue'; the Investors form asks for $6M+ revenue.

items.title: EBITDA of $3M–$6M and revenue of $10M–$40M
items.body: Our sweet spot is $3M–$6M in EBITDA, with a floor of about $1.5M.

items.title: Benefits from utilizing technology
items.body: We focus on businesses that distribute, implement, and support technology for their customers.

items.title: Strong management teams
items.body: Your leadership team stays in place and your operating expertise stays at the center.

items.title: Established and growing
items.body: Businesses that are typically 4–12 years old, headquartered in the US or Canada.

items.title: Shared values
items.body: Confident, human, collaborative, candid, and caring. The deal should fit the business.
